full_text: (a) Each head of department or office of a province, city, municipality or Barangay shall be primarily accountable for all government property assigned or issued to his department or office. The person or persons entrusted with the possession or custody of government property under the accountability of any head of department or office shall be immediately accountable to such officer. (b) The head of a department or office primarily accountable for government property may any person in possession of the property or having custody and control thereof under him to keep such records and make reports as may be necessary for his own information and protection. (c) Buildings and other physical structures shall be under the accountability and responsibility of the provincial or city general services officer or the municipal mayor or Punong Barangay, as the case may be. (d) Every officer primarily accountable for government property shall keep a complete record of all properties under his charge and render his accounts therefor semiannually to the provincial or city general services officer or the municipal mayor or Punong Barangay, as the case may be.
